entities.name: Dragoš Kalajić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dragoš Kalajić was a Serbian painter, philosopher, art critic, writer and member of the Senate of Republika Srpska. He was one of the most prominent Serbian nationalists throughout the 1980s and 1990s. He was a member of the Association of Artists of Serbia, the Association of Writers of Serbia and the Union of Russian Writers.
